description: Commits selected files within workspace items to the connected Git repository.
notes: Commit is an LRO. Use --commit-all for all changes, --items ID1,ID2 for object-ID item selection, or repeat --file-selection ITEM_ID=PATH for FileLevelSelective mode. Use --logical-file-selection for logical IDs. --all-files-for-item and --all-files-for-logical-item emit an empty selectedFiles array, which commits every file in that item. workspaceHead is auto-fetched.

query_examples.description: Error details if failed (null on success).
